seo.titulo: CapCut-style clip editor for agencies | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Edit your clients' clips in a CapCut-style editor: trims, cuts, silence removal, auto-framing and 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9. It saves on its own. Built for agencies.

destacado: without a senior editor on every one
bajada: Trim, cut what's extra and frame whoever is talking in a CapCut-style editor. Clipfine does the heavy lifting and your team reviews, so anyone on your team can deliver clean clips.

d1.que: of undo and redo on every clip

d2.que: that can change in every segment

d3.que: 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9, whatever each network asks for

agencia.editor: Your team already knows it: if they've ever opened CapCut, there's no learning curve.
agencia.guardado: Nobody loses an hour of work because a tab closed or the internet dropped.
agencia.tramo: The clip starts with the full idea, and the client doesn't ask you to redo it because it got cut off.
agencia.cortes: You remove a mistake or a filler word in seconds, without exporting or jumping to another app.
agencia.silencios: The most tedious pass on a clip becomes one tap and a quick review.
agencia.autoEncuadre: The step that eats most of an editor's time happens on its own. Your team reviews instead of framing.
agencia.encuadreManual: When the AI misses, you fix it in seconds without starting over.
agencia.formatos: You deliver the format each of the client's networks asks for without another app.
agencia.disenos: Two-person interviews look good vertical, without building a split screen by hand.
agencia.fondo: Any video fits vertical without ugly edges, including footage shot horizontally.
agencia.velocidad: A clip that runs past the ideal length fits without cutting content.

p1.p: Does my team need to know video editing?
p1.r: No. Framing, silences and cuts are suggested automatically, and the editor works like CapCut. Anyone on your team can get a clip ready.

p2.p: What happens if the browser closes mid-edit?
p2.r: Nothing is lost. Every change saves on its own a second after you make it, and undo keeps the last 100 steps.

p3.p: Can my team edit from their phone?
p3.r: Yes. The iPhone and Android app has the editor, with the same account and the same clips as the web.
